title: Tenant-prioritized SLI throttles and cost-aware observability for analytics pipeline
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem statement: Our analytics ingest and query pipeline occasionally triggers high-cost downstream traces and logs for a small subset of tenants. These hot tenants inflate telemetry costs and obscure signal for other customers, increasing noise in dashboards and causing false alert storms. We need a production-safe approach to prioritize tenant signal, limit cost exposure, and preserve meaningful SLIs for the majority of users.

Goal: Implement tenant-prioritized SLI budgeting and throttles at the analytics ingestion and query aggregation layers, plus enrich tracing/logging with compacted, per-journey samples. Deliver improved SLI fidelity, reduced telemetry cost, and a phased rollout with clear rollback paths.

Scope: backend console analytics services (ingest, aggregator, sampler), tracing sampling and index compaction, dashboard filters and SLO compute changes. Out of scope: frontend console UI redesign and billing rules.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Per-tenant telemetry budget implemented: each tenant has a configurable daily tracing/logging budget and soft limit enforcement.
2) When a tenant exceeds soft budget, throttles apply to high-cardinality debug logs and trace capture while preserving top-level SLIs.
3) New SLI computation pipeline uses weighted tenant sampling to avoid being dominated by noisy tenants.
4) Dashboards updated to show tenant-level telemetry spend and SLI contribution.
5) Rollout plan validated in staging using synthetic journeys and must show telemetry cost reduction >= 20% for noisy tenants without degrading 95th-percentile query SLO for other tenants.
6) Runbook and rollback steps documented and reviewed by SRE and Product.
implementation_plan:
Phase 1 - Design (done): define budget model, throttle points (ingest-messages, trace-span capture, debug-log ingestion), and metrics to track. Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ANALYTICS/Tenant+SLI+Budgeting (internal).

Phase 2 - Enforce soft quotas (in progress): implement middleware at ingestion gateway to annotate events with tenant_budget_status, add a non-blocking throttle that drops or demotes fields for debug logs and low-value traces. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4823.

Phase 3 - Sampling & SLI compute (upcoming): change SLI aggregator to use weighted sampling config per tenant and incorporate budget_state into SLI weighting. Add a compaction pass for trace indexes to collapse repeated spans from the same tenant session.

Phase 4 - Dashboard + Alerts: add tenant telemetry spend panels in Grafana and adjust alert rules to use tenant-weighted SLI baselines.

Phase 5 - Rollout and experimentation: Canary to 10% of traffic (non-enterprise), monitor cost and SLO impact for 2 weeks, expand to 50% then all tenants.
rollout_plan:
- Canary group: microservices handling non-enterprise tenants (start date 2025-03-12).
- Monitoring window: continuous; key checkpoints at 24h, 72h, 7d.
- Success criteria to progress: no >5% regression in 95th percentile query latency for non-canary tenants and >= 20% telemetry cost reduction for canary noisy tenants.
- Fallback: disable middleware flag via feature gate, revert PR for sampling changes, and re-run ingestion replays to validate.
- Communication: Slack #sre-alerts and #platform-rollouts, and update customers via status page if any degradation expected.
monitoring_signals:
- Per-tenant: telemetry_bytes_ingested, trace_spans_captured, debug_log_count, telemetry_cost_estimate_usd.
- SLIs: query_success_rate, p50/p95 query_latency, ingestion_accept_rate.
- Platform: sampling_rate_by_tenant, dropped_span_rate, alerts_triggered_by_tenant.
- Dashboards: grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/analytics/tenant-telemetry-overview (internal).
open_questions:
- What is the appropriate default daily budget for new tenants? (Product to propose)
- Should enterprise tenants have an override to opt out of throttles? (Security/Product policy)
- Do we need KMS/HSM changes when compaction touches PII in spans? (Security review required if yes)
- What cost model do we use to estimate telemetry_cost_estimate_usd (storage vs compute)?
